ὁδός.shortDefinition: a way, highway; fig. a journey

ὅθεν.shortDefinition: from where/which; fig. for that reason

οἶδα.shortDefinition: to see; fig. to know, notice

οἰκοδομέω.shortDefinition: to establish, build; fig. to instruct, improve, edify

ὄνομα.shortDefinition: a name; fig. an authority/power, representation

ὄπισθεν.shortDefinition: to be behind; fig. on the back of

ὁράω.shortDefinition: to observe, stare at; fig: to see clearly, watch out

Οὐρίας.shortDefinition: Uriah, Urijah; lit. Flame of YH/Yah/Jah
